justification: The most specific correspondence is a long-tailed quadruped rendered in shallow, flat profile relief occupying the upper part of a tall upright slab with a shaped top edge, in both cases seen in situ among rough stonework. The biggest difference is density and organisation: B is crowded with stacked registers of birds, a patterned band, snakes and further creatures, while A carries a single isolated animal on an otherwise blank, smooth grey face.
